reviewer: root, not the author of the formatter runner/workflow/bundle

review.runner: Entire 13,675-byte Python runner read. It validates first push/branch/attempt, materializes exactly 15 fixed UTF-8 inputs under a new RUNNER_TEMP directory, invokes only rustup lookup/version, rustc version observation and rustfmt text formatting; no Cargo, compiler build, test or product run.
review.source_binding: Each candidate SHA-256 and size matches its fixed latest author handoff, with statistics full-body equality to root-reviewed bc1106 and direct full Git reads for final database/server helpers and a472 backfill. Controller and copy snapshots use actual checked-out HEAD and Git bytes before/after. Formatter binary and explicit empty config are checked before/after.
review.configuration: Root independently read the complete G4866 root tree (13 entries) and crates recursive tree (1,298 entries), both untruncated, with no rustfmt.toml or .rustfmt.toml. Original Cargo root bytes match the configuration proof and edition 2021. Five crate inheritance is recorded by the author; actual formatter release/output remains unobserved.
review.commands: Exact 1.95.0 toolchain is installed; actual rustfmt lookup and executable digest/version are retained. Each stdin source uses --edition 2021 --emit stdout and a new empty config. Formatter children receive only PATH/HOME/RUSTUP_HOME/CARGO_HOME/LANG/LC_ALL. No credential or arbitrary Rust/loader environment is forwarded.
review.failure: Every attempted command retains complete original stdout/stderr base64, exit, timing and input identity. Invalid UTF-8 or empty output or nonzero/timeout marks the candidate failed; later candidate attempts remain separate. Final accepted status requires all 15 plus unchanged inputs. No automatic code correction occurs.
review.delivery: Read exact six-file order and schema p8-candidate-rustfmt-frame-v1: formatted-sources.json, commands.json, stderr.log, source-before.json, source-after.json, receipt.json. Enforces <=4 MiB each, <=12 MiB total, 1 KiB raw chunk, <=2 KiB physical JSON line with full file/chunk hashes. Commands JSON retains full stdout; no missing stdout-only dependency.
review.workflow: Entire fixed workflow read. Only exact new branch push, ubuntu-24.04, 20 minutes, read-only contents, checkout actual github.sha, persist-credentials false, first attempt check, fixed runner/plan/bundle hash verification. Always-upload preserves the owned directory. No original workflow modified.
review.product_review_scope: Candidate source reading also confirmed the final two CPU/semantic blocking closure permits surround diagnostic tails, and the added blocking-writer control; no actual Rust test execution is claimed by this formatting review.

publication_requirements.next: Root must inspect actual created tree/commit and fresh absent branch before first publication.

limitations: Static source review is not Python/Rust execution.
A passed formatting receipt does not certify compile, Clippy, normal CI, or runtime observations.
Hard termination or missing final frames stays incomplete, without reconstructed substitute evidence.
